devicePlayingDelete: Play a different video before deleting this one.
deviceDeleteIntro: This video will be permanently deleted from the holographic device:
deviceDeleteNote: This cannot be undone. Downloaded copies on your phone and purchase records will remain.
deviceConnectFirst: Connect your device in Controls first.
frameSaved: Framing saved. The original video is unchanged; it has not been converted or uploaded.
frameSaveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
frameCircle: The circle marks the device display area.
frameInstructions: Pinch to zoom and drag to reposition. Play the full video to check that the character and movements stay inside the circle.
framePlaybackFailed: Playback failed. Go back and try again.
frameFitNote: Fit keeps the entire frame. Fill crops the edges.
frameRestoreFailed: Saved framing could not be loaded. Adjust and save it again.
framePending: Only framing is saved for now. Device video conversion is not yet available.
framePreviewFailed: Preview could not load. Go back and try again.
